name: EAA Chapter 43 Monthly Meeting
notes: Monthly meeting of EAA Chapter 43 — Colorado's oldest EAA chapter (est. 1958) — in the Flatirons Room upstairs at the KBJC terminal. Covers aircraft building, safety topics, and more. All aviation enthusiasts welcome.

name: Breakfast Fly-In: Food Drive
notes: Monthly breakfast fly-in at Wings Over the Rockies Exploration of Flight. Bring a non-perishable food item for Food Bank of the Rockies. Food truck on site; aircraft on display. Pilots fly in for a free breakfast. Weather permitting.

name: Boulder Airport Association Monthly Meeting
notes: Monthly meeting of the Boulder Airport Association at Boulder Municipal Airport.

name: EAA Chapter 72 Meeting
notes: EAA Chapter 72 weekend meeting at Meadow Lake Airport near Colorado Springs. Sign up with the organizer via Colorado Pilots Association.

name: Astronomy Night: Planet Party
notes: Stargazing event at Wings Over the Rockies Exploration of Flight. Get up close with planets through telescopes — all ages invited.

name: EAA Chapter 43 Monthly Meeting
notes: December meeting of EAA Chapter 43 in the Flatirons Room at KBJC terminal. Holiday edition — all aviation enthusiasts welcome.

name: Wings Breakfast Fly-In: December
notes: Second Saturday monthly breakfast fly-in at Wings Over the Rockies Exploration of Flight. Food truck on site; aircraft on display. Pilots fly in for a free breakfast. Weather permitting.

name: EAA Chapter 43 Monthly Meeting
notes: First meeting of 2027 for EAA Chapter 43 — Colorado's oldest EAA chapter — in the Flatirons Room at KBJC terminal. All welcome.

name: Wings Breakfast Fly-In: January
notes: Second Saturday monthly breakfast fly-in at Wings Over the Rockies Exploration of Flight at Centennial Airport. Food truck on site. Pilots fly in for a free breakfast.
